vulnerabilities.title: Optimizely Web Experimentation
vulnerabilities.name: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.
vulnerabilities.short_description: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account...
vulnerabilities.fix: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

vulnerabilities.title: Idunno AntiCsrf
vulnerabilities.name: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

vulnerabilities.title: Drupal Core
vulnerabilities.name: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.
